time_basis: Top plots use fixed PST (UTC-08:00). Original logger timestamps are retained in the detailed records. Before the USB clock correction on 2026-11-12 at approximately 13:34 PST, Top used approximately UTC-07:00 and was about 36 seconds fast; the derived PST times remove the one-hour offset but do not correct that small drift. Subsequent Top records use PST. The clock change can affect the duration of summary intervals spanning the correction. Lower clock remains unverified.

soil.installation: Top T and U installed at the surface, confirmed by user 2026-11-02

sap.method: Per-sensor minimum–maximum scaling over available water-year observations. Constant or missing series remain undefined.

notes: Preliminary sensor observations; calibration remains under review.
Both soil locations are GroPoints T and U at Top. Lower is not represented.

Profiles interpolate between sensor positions and across time gaps no longer than 45 minutes. Moisture layer means are interpolated at layer midpoints and held within the outer half-layers; temperature is not extrapolated outside sensor depths.
Zero is a measured value; missing values remain missing.
Absolute sapflow and original records are available in the detailed Data view.
